from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel

def test_panel_title_style():
    console = Console()
    # Panel with background style "on blue"
    panel = Panel("Content", title="Title", style="on blue")
    
    segments = list(console.render(panel))
    
    title_found = False
    for segment in segments:
        if "Title" in segment.text:
            title_found = True
            # The title segment should inherit the panel's background style.
            # In rich, styles are additive. style="on blue" should be present.
            assert "on blue" in str(segment.style), f"Title segment style {segment.style} does not contain 'on blue'"
    
    assert title_found, "Title not found in rendered segments"

test_panel_title_style()
